purpose: Coverage-first measurement of the first non-pass task in the fixed 189-task development ledger under the unchanged current generic candidate.
change_scope: No task-driven code change. Measure the unchanged generic candidate on the first non-pass ledger task using a fresh VM and immutable result directory.

implementation_evidence.hypothesis: The unchanged v36 candidate omitted paragraph.set_format from the initial top seven despite an explicit strikethrough request. Qwen selected paragraph.apply_split_tabstop, mutated all nonempty paragraphs, and completed without applying strikethrough. Generic formatting vocabulary should expose the existing typed action and let Qwen select the target ordinal and format arguments itself.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Routing tests use meeting notes, a legal draft, a policy memo, and explicit paragraph-number formatting. They cover strike-through, cross-out, alignment, and line-spacing requests, and prove paragraph.set_format outranks the unrelated split-tabstop action for crossed-out words. No course content, source filename, task identity, or fixed paragraph ordinal appears in changed sources.
implementation_evidence.current_instruction_router_check: paragraph.set_format is third in the seven-action candidate list after document.inspect and document.save; paragraph.apply_split_tabstop is sixth.
implementation_evidence.prior_v36_outcome: Original evaluator 0.0 after six model turns. The top seven omitted paragraph.set_format. Qwen inspected, saved, selected paragraph.apply_split_tabstop with word_count 1, changed all three nonempty paragraphs, inspected, and terminated while claiming the still-unperformed strikethrough could be applied through the toolbar.
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes
implementation_evidence.changed_source_leakage_scan: No current task UUID, source episode ID, task filename, course text, golden value, or evaluator expected state appears in changed runtime or test sources.
